description: A bearded man with a topknot, in a grey robe, sits at a wooden table in a dark room, pressing two fingers onto a seated younger person's outstretched wrist. A candle flame glows at the left edge. A small cushion sits under the wrist, a brush and ink stone lie on the table, a bundle of bamboo slips is unrolled beside them, and a ceramic jar and bowl sit at the right. The painting is an oil-style scene with no visible text, no frame and no blood.
